newsitem.title: USA: Three Infosafe board members resign.
newsitem.headline: Three Infosafe board members resign.

text.p: Infosafe Systems Inc said on Friday that three of its board members had resigned as part of a restructuring that began in December.
The members were Alan Alpern, Frank Schwab and William Walker, Infosafe said in a statement. In addition, the company said Neal Freeman was appointed to its board of directors.

Freeman is chairman and chief executive of the privately owned television production company Blackwell Corp. He also founded and served for 12 years as president and chief executive of Jefferson Communications Inc, a feature syndicate that was sold in 1986.
Infosafe Systems Inc develops proprietary distribution systems that meter the use of digital information.
